# first-split: the string cut at the separator's first occurrence, before and after, or the string alone where it does not occur; a separator of several characters, at either end, around characters past ASCII; an empty separator, and a value that is not a string, are type errors.
def export [input] (join "|" (map (fn [x] (string-join "," (map quoted (first-split "=" x)))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "|" (map (fn [x] (string-join "," (map quoted (first-split " (" x)))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (string-join "|" (push-all (first-split "=" "key") (first-split "=" "key=a=b")))
def export [input] (join "|" (map (fn [x] (string-join "," (first-split "" x))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "|" (map (fn [x] (string-join "," (first-split "=" x))) (select (path each-index) input)))

# starts-with, ends-with and contains: exact, code point by code point, so é is not e and a letter is not its other case; an empty part is in every string, the empty string too; a value that is not a string is a type error where it is met.
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (if (starts-with "é" x) "y" "n")) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (string-join "," [(if (starts-with "é" "école") "true" "false") (if (starts-with "e" "école") "true" "false")])
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (if (ends-with "/" x) "y" "n")) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (if (contains "@" x) "y" "n")) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (if (contains "ß" x) "y" "n")) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (string-join "" [(if (starts-with "" x) "s" "-") (if (ends-with "" x) "e" "-") (if (contains "" x) "c" "-")])) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (string-join "" [(if (starts-with "😀" x) "s" "-") (if (ends-with "😀" x) "e" "-") (if (contains "😀" x) "c" "-")])) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (if (starts-with "a" x) "y" "n")) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (if (ends-with "a" x) "y" "n")) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (if (contains "a" x) "y" "n")) (select (path each-index) input)))

# flatten: one level out, each item that is a vector giving its items in their order and any other item kept, a vector inside one of those kept a vector; a value that is not a vector is a type error where it is met.
def export [input] (join "|" (map (fn [x] (scalar-text csv-options (flatten x))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (scalar-text csv-options (flatten [[1 2] 3 [] [[4]]]))
def export [input] (join "|" (map (fn [x] (scalar-text csv-options (flatten x))) (select (path each-index) input)))

# get-or: the value under the key, a null among them, or the default where get answers missing, the key absent or the data missing; a key that is a string reads as a keyword does; data that is not an object is INPUT_INVALID, as get finds it.
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (scalar-text csv-options (get-or :fill "-" x))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (scalar-text csv-options (get-or "fill" (get-or :b "-" x) (get :a x)))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (scalar-text csv-options (get-or :fill "-" x))) (select (path each-index) input)))

# add and sub: exact over whole numbers, without the lexeme they were spelled with, up to 2^53 - 1 either way, and zero is 0, never -0; sub a b is a less b; an operand that is fractional or past that range, or not a number, and a result past it, are type errors where they are met.
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (scalar-text csv-options (add x 1))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (scalar-text csv-options (sub x 1))) (select (path each-index) input)))

def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (string-join "/" [(scalar-text csv-options (add x x)) (scalar-text csv-options (sub x x)) (scalar-text csv-options (sub 0 x))])) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (scalar-text csv-options (sub 3 5))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (scalar-text csv-options (add x 1))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (scalar-text csv-options (add x 1))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (scalar-text csv-options (add x 1))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (scalar-text csv-options (add x 1))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "," (map (fn [x] (scalar-text csv-options (sub x 1))) (select (path each-index) input)))

# sort: a finite vector of numbers, by value, or of strings, by code point, stable, so 0 and -0 keep their order and a number its lexeme; é after z, and a character past U+FFFF after U+FFFF, where UTF-16 code units put it before; a vector of both kinds, of another kind, or holding NaN is a type error where it is met.
def export [input] (join "|" (map (fn [x] (string-join "," (map (partial scalar-text csv-options) (sort x)))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "|" (map (fn [x] (string-join "," (map quoted (sort x)))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (string-join "," (map quoted (sort ["z" "é" "a"])))
def export [input] (join "|" (map (fn [x] (string-join "," (map quoted (sort x)))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "|" (map (fn [x] (string-join "," (map quoted (sort x)))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "|" (map (fn [x] (string-join "," (map quoted (sort x)))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "|" (map (fn [x] (string-join "," (map quoted (sort x)))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "|" (map (fn [x] (string-join "," (map quoted (sort x)))) (select (path each-index) input)))
def export [input] (join "|" (map (fn [x] (string-join "," (map (partial scalar-text csv-options) (sort [1 (number x)])))) (select (path each-index) input)))

# A let of several names binds each in turn, each in scope for the bindings after it and for the body, and a later binding of a name shadows the earlier; a stream may be bound among them, and is read once.
def export [input]\n  let [a 1 b (inc a) c (add a b)]\n    scalar-text csv-options c
def export [input]\n  let [a 1 a (add a 10) b a]\n    scalar-text csv-options b
def export [input]\n  let [sep "," items (select (path each-index) input)]\n    join sep (map (partial scalar-text csv-options) items)
